description:
Yes ok, "technically" this is already a Gelato but....... I'm sure you can forgive me 😉

I started this Mango ice cream to accommodate those that want it but using canned fruit as opposed to fresh fruit. This is soooo close to what I wanted to achieve, it's got a perfect texture and consistency but I need more natural colour and flavour. 

With the above in mind, this is a beautiful Mango ice cream if you want to give it a try. I will do a very quick second version with much lower fat to not only get better colour but stronger flavour too so stay tuned!!

For this Mango ice cream, you will need:
300g Canned Mango Flesh
350g Milk @ 2%
300g Cream @ 33%
97g Sugar
55g Dextrose
95g Skim Milk Powder
1.5g Xanthan Gum 

I am trying to remember to use Fahrenheit now as well as Celcius 😉😂

------------------------

If you like fruit ice cream, check out this amazing Japanese Apple ice cream:
